تحتبسن (form VIII)
# تَحْتَبِسْنَ (taḥtabisna) /taħ.ta.bis.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
# تُحْتَبَسْنَ (tuḥtabasna) /tuħ.ta.bas.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
